title: From Delegates to Trustees: How Optimizing for Long-Term Interests Shapes Bias and Alignment in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Simulating votes on U.S. policy issues using synthetic voter profiles and comparing model predictions under 'delegate' (mirroring user preferences) versus 'trustee' (optimizing for long-term utility) conditions. The study measures how often the outcomes align with the model's default, often liberal-leaning stances across different political affiliations (Democrat, Republican, Independent).

Analyzing the divergence in simulated policy voting outcomes between user-expressed preferences (delegate condition) and model-driven long-term utility decisions (trustee condition) across synthetic voter profiles of varying income brackets (e.g., under $50K, $50K-100K, over $100K).
